title: Telesales Agent -Disappointing Experience
body:
I have always heard great reviews about ADIB from my friends, which is why I was confident in approaching the bank for a loan. However, my experience with your telesales agent, Mohammed Nour, has been highly disappointing.

From the very first conversation via phone, Mohammed appeared diligent and asked me to send my documents. I complied, but to my surprise, he requested that I send everything via WhatsApp rather than through email, which seemed unusual. I was transparent in sharing all the necessary details, including potential issues related to my low AECB score and my company’s profile, so that I could understand upfront if I was eligible for the loan.

Despite my concerns, Mohammed assured me that the loan would be approved. He continued to promise the same since the first week of November. However, last week, I received a call from him stating that the loan could not be sanctioned, citing the very reasons I had brought up during our first conversation.

What made the situation worse was Mohammed’s lack of professionalism. He repeatedly failed to answer or return my calls, leaving me in the dark about the status of my application. When I confronted him about his unresponsiveness, he simply stated that he was too busy, which is unacceptable when dealing with customers’ financial matters.

This experience has not only caused me inconvenience but also shattered the trust I had in ADIB based on its reputation. I urge the bank to look into this matter seriously to ensure better training and accountability for your telesales agents. Transparency and timely communication should be the cornerstone of your customer service.

I hope ADIB takes corrective measures to prevent other customers from facing similar issues.
author: ShireenS Bahis

reply.body: Hello, Thank you for rating us. We apologize for the less than satisfactory experience you have encountered. title: Outdated device management which is stuck in 2010
body:
ADIB’s mobile app desperately needs a device management feature. Every other bank whether local or international allows you to log in on a new phone simply by completing a proper authentication step (OTP, biometric verification, etc.). With ADIB, changing your phone means you’re forced to call the call center just to unlink your old device.

And to make matters worse, the call center charges you per minute for the call. So not only is the process needlessly inconvenient, it’s also costing customers money for a problem that should be self-serviceable within the app itself.
This is basic functionality in 2026. 

A dedicated “Manage Devices” section in the app where users can view and remove linked devices securely is table stakes for any modern banking app. Please prioritize this fix. It’s frustrating, time-consuming and frankly, embarrassing for a bank of ADIB’s size.

title: طريقة البحث
body:
انا اتمنى من بنك مثل هذا المستوى ان يحسن من طريقة البحث في موضوع تحويل الاموال مب حاله هاي انا اقعد ١٠ دقايق ادور ع اسم المستفيد ليش ما اقدر ابحث عن طريق رقم الحساب و اخلص و افتك اذا مثلا مسجل عندي ٤ محمد لازم ادخل ع واحد واحد ادور ع رقم حساب الشخص المعني
و اذا ناسي انا شو مسجل الشخص هذا و عندي لسته طويله باسامي الناس نفترض عندي ف التطبيق ٤٠ شخص مسجل و الشخص الي ابا ارسل المبلغ له ناسي شو مسجل عليه اقعد ادخل حساب حساب لين اعرف رقم حساب الشخص
لدرجه ان عادي اطلع من اديب و السبب هذا الموضوع جوفو حل خلو الناس ترتاح تبحث عن طريق رقم الحساب

title: المسجات عن طريق التطبيق
body:
الخدمة جداً سيئة الاشعارات عبر التطبيق االخدمة السابقة عن طريق الرسائل كانت سريعة الان تتأخر و اذا كانت الباقة منتهية انسى أن يصلك شيء حتى تجد خدمة انترنت تواصلت معاهم قالوا أن اغلق الخدمة في التطبيق و ستصلني مسجات عندما أغلقتها لم يتغير شيء و لم تصلني أي رسالة 

( بخصوص الرد بالايميل تشرح فيها كيف أفعل الاشعارات 
لم تفهم مقصدي لا أريد اشعارات االتطبيق أريد الطريقة التقليدية عن طريق الرسائل النصية ) 

و بخصوص الايميلات باللغة الانجليزية التي لا أفهم ما سبب تمسكهم باللغة الانجليزية في دولة عربية رغم مطالبتي الدائمة بان تكون جميع رسائلي الالكترونية بالعربية و هي لغتي الام و المفضلة بحجة أنهم لا يستطيعون تحويلها للعربية مادام لا تستطيع تحويلها للغتي المفضلة لا ترسلها لي لست بحاجة لشيء لا أفهمه أنا أتحدث بالعربية فقط

title: Basics but not well advanced compared to Western banks
body:
This app gives good basics to manage your Adib bank accounts, incl. some self service options however it is way behind what other Western banks offer in their bank applications. The bank should look at online banks like Revolut but also well established digital banks like Abn Amro, Rabobank + others. European banks also offer new customers to open both a personal or business account online within a few mins. Something that takes much paperwork/uploading for UAE Banks. Not even talking about Business accounts taking months to open (versus a few mins online in Europe).

A few of many things missing:
- To some accounts you can only wire a foreign currency instead of opting for just sending AED to use the foreigns conversion rate. They basically force you to use the ADIB conversion rate. You need to visit a bank office to wire in AED.
- Transactions sometimes show foreign currency value and you need to click on it to see the AED amount.
- Transactions don’t show how many Emirates miles you earned
- There is not an advances analytics tool, showing how much money you spent per category (for example gas, food etc) in a month.
- You cannot change your home address in the app.
- You cannot book a video call with a bank advisor to get advice on topics from the comfort of your home.
